title: Justine
author: Marquis de Sade
current_text: In 1791, authorities in France suppressed Justine or the Misfortunes of Virtue.

sources.quote:
1791, France: The authorities doggedly suppressed "Justine or the
Misfortunes of Virtue" and Juliette."
sources.title: Sade, "Justine or the Misfortunes of Virtue", "Juliette"

ban_rows.note: A translation of Justine was considered by the NZ Indecent Publications Tribunal in 1965; Juliette (1969) was held indecent except for bona fide students over 20.

Banned in Malaysia by the Ministry of Home Affairs (KDN) under the Printing Presses and Publications Act. Gazetted 1999-12-30 (P.U. (A) 517). Publisher: Book of The Month Club, New York. Printer: -. Language: INGGERIS.
